create_HybridAttnBackend: create a HybridAttnBackend that delegates prefill and decode operations to separate attention backends
select_backend_forward_mode: select the appropriate prefill or decode attention backend based on forward mode
init_forward_metadata: initialize forward metadata for a batch using the selected attention backend
init_cuda_graph_state: initialize CUDA graph states for decode and optionally prefill backends
run_forward_attention: run the attention forward pass by delegating to the selected backend based on forward mode
